svg.text: #592 Enterprise Reasoning Models (DeepSeek-R1/QwQ): <think> Budget Router & KV Stripping
Cloud & AI Solution Architect Guide · 55/30/15 Adaptive Thinking Effort Router (-75.6% Output Tokens) · Strip Prior-Turn <think> (-74.2% KV RAM)
1. The "Overthinking" Little's Law HBM Crisis
✕ Unconstrained <think> on Every Request (50 QPS Peak)
• Generates 3,450 <think> tokens + 400 answer tokens = 3,850 out tokens/req
• Hold Time W = 49.4s → Little's Law Concurrency L = 2,470 active seqs → 32× H200!
✓ 3-Tier Adaptive Thinking Effort Router (55% / 30% / 15%)
• Tier 0 (55% Routine Queries): Force immediate </think> (0 think + 350 ans = 350 tok)
• Tier 1 (30% Analytical Queries): Cap think budget at 640 tok (+350 ans = 990 tok)
• Tier 2 (15% Hard Math/Root-Cause): Full 2,600 think tok (+400 ans = 3,000 tok)
• Blended Output Drops from 3,850 to 940 tokens/req (-75.6% Decode FLOPs & Hold Time!)
• Fleet shrinks from 32× H200 ($108.8k/mo) to 8× H200 ($27.2k/mo, -75.0%) @ 98.6% Acc!
2. Multi-Turn <think> KV Stripping & Soft Budget Forcing
Rule 1: Strip Completed <think> Blocks from Multi-Turn History
• In a 6-turn session, retaining prior turns' <think> traces bloats context to 28,400 tok
• Stripping <think>...</think> after each turn keeps only user + final answers (7,320 tok)
• Reduces multi-turn HBM KV Cache footprint by 74.2% AND improves turn-6 accuracy!
• Compatible with vLLM / SGLang reasoning-parser auto-strip hooks
Rule 2: Soft Budget Forcing vs. Hard max_tokens Truncation
• Never use hard max_tokens truncation (cuts off inside <think> with 0 final answer!)

• When thinking tokens hit budget N_think, inject "
Final summary:
</think>
" via
custom LogitsProcessor so the model cleanly transitions to emitting the final JSON/answer
• Eliminates 100% of empty-answer truncation failures
3. UX Streaming Separation Rule (SSE reasoning_content vs. content)
• Stream delta.reasoning_content into a collapsible muted UI drawer at 120ms throttled intervals while measuring True TTFT vs. Answer TTFT.
• Combine MTP (Multi-Token Prediction) on DeepSeek-R1/V3 to accelerate <think> rollout speed by 1.85x (TPOT 18ms → 9.7ms).
